// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A school's request for a copy of a class's data sits in CREDENTIAL_NEVER: the
// reason is free text an admin writes and will sometimes name a child in, and
// the row is one join from a Class. No read of any shape, not even a count that
// would say which schools are being asked for their records.
export async function outstandingExportRequests() {
  return db.exportRequest.findMany({ where: { fulfilledAt: null }, take: 20 });
}
